 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time: Check Moon Sighting Timings in USA, Canada, UK, UAE and Other Countries
 By IE Author - October 29, 2026 
 Source: ChatGPT 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 is an important Hindu festival celebrated by married women who pray for their husbands’ long life, good health and happiness. Many women observe a day-long fast and break it after sighting the Moon and completing traditional evening rituals. 
 This year, Karwa Chauth falls on Thursday, October 29, 2026, in India, while many cities in the United States and Canada observe the festival on Wednesday, October 28. The local observance date can differ because of the relationship between the lunar tithi, local time and applicable Hindu calendar rules. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Date: October 28 or October 29? 
 Karwa Chauth takes place on Krishna Paksha Chaturthi, the fourth day of the waning Moon in the Hindu lunar calendar. It is also known as Karak Chaturthi. In India, the festival falls on October 29, 2026. However, many Hindu communities in the USA and Canada observe Karwa Chauth on October 28. 
 This difference occurs because the Hindu lunar day, known as a tithi, does not follow a fixed midnight-to-midnight calendar. A tithi is determined by the angular relationship between the Sun and the Moon. Its beginning and ending times are expressed in local clock time, which varies by time zone. Local religious calendar rules also determine which date is selected for the observance. 
 People living abroad should check a reliable, city-specific Panchang rather than automatically follow the Indian calendar date. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time Worldwide: City-Wise List 
 The Karwa Chauth 2026 moon sighting time varies across countries and cities. The following sections provide estimated local moonrise timings for major international locations. Timings may differ slightly between astronomical calculators and religious calendars, so check the local Panchang before planning the fast-breaking rituals. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time in USA 
 Karwa Chauth is observed on October 28, 2026, in several major cities across the United States. In Washington, D.C., the estimated Moon rise time is around 7:55 PM EDT, while in New York, the expected moonrise time is 7:35 PM EDT. 
 The New York moonrise time corresponds to approximately 5:05 AM IST on October 29 in India. However, people observing Karwa Chauth in New York should follow their local time rather than the Indian time conversion. 
 Moonrise also varies in other American cities, including Chicago, Houston, Dallas and Los Angeles. Women observing the fast should check the timing for their exact location before preparing for the evening puja. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time in India 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 falls on Thursday, October 29, in India. The moonrise time varies across major Indian cities. In New Delhi, the Moon is expected to rise at 8:17 PM IST, while in Mumbai, the expected moonrise time is 9:00 PM IST. At Pune, the Moon is expected to rise at 8:58 PM IST, followed by Bengaluru at 8:55 PM IST, Hyderabad at 8:41 PM IST and Chennai at 8:44 PM IST. 
 Eastern India, the expected Karwa Chauth 2026 moonrise time is 7:47 PM IST in Kolkata and 7:52 PM IST in Patna. Meanwhile, the Moon is expected to rise at 8:52 PM IST in Ahmedabad, 8:28 PM IST in Jaipur, 8:06 PM IST in Lucknow and 8:12 PM IST in Chandigarh. In Madhya Pradesh, the expected moonrise timings are 8:31 PM IST in Bhopal and 8:39 PM IST in Indore. 
 These are approximate moonrise timings in Indian Standard Time (IST). Published calendars may differ by a few minutes. Women observing the Karwa Chauth fast should check their local Panchang for the applicable Moon sighting time before performing the evening rituals and breaking their fast. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time in Canada 
 In Canada, Karwa Chauth is observed on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, in Toronto and Vancouver. The Karwa Chauth 2026 moonrise time in Toronto is approximately 7:45 PM EDT, while the Moon is expected to rise in Vancouver at around 7:18 PM PDT. 
 Toronto and Vancouver follow different time zones. As a result, devotees should check the timing for their own city instead of relying on a general Canada moonrise schedule. After moonrise, women can complete the traditional Moon worship and break their fast according to their family customs. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time in UK and Europe 
 In London, Karwa Chauth falls on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The Moon is expected to rise at approximately 6:31 PM GMT. 
 For Indians living in Germany and France, the estimated moonrise time is around 7:15 PM CET in Frankfurt and Paris. However, actual moonrise times can differ between these cities, even though they share the same time zone. Devotees in the UK and Europe should use city-specific moonrise timings when planning their evening celebrations. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, UAE 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 falls on Thursday, October 29, in the United Arab Emirates. According to published estimates, the Moon is expected to rise at around 8:28 PM Gulf Standard Time in Dubai and 8:34 PM in Abu Dhabi. 
 The UAE is 1 hour and 30 minutes behind India. Therefore, 8:28 PM in Dubai corresponds to 9:58 PM IST on October 29. 
 Women living in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and other parts of the UAE should confirm the local moonrise time before performing the fast-breaking rituals. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time in Australia, Singapore, New Zealand and South Africa 
 Karwa Chauth is also observed by Hindu communities in Australia, Singapore, New Zealand and South Africa. 
 In Australia, the estimated moonrise time is 11:14 PM AEDT in Sydney and approximately 11:55 PM AEDT in Melbourne on October 29. This means devotees may have to wait until late at night to complete the traditional fast-breaking rituals. 
 In Singapore, the expected moonrise time is approximately 10:02 PM SGT. In Auckland, New Zealand, the Moon is expected to rise at around 11:47 PM NZDT. The moonrise time in Johannesburg, South Africa, requires further confirmation from a reliable local astronomical calendar before publication. 
 As the Moon rises at different times across these regions, devotees should refer to local calendars for accurate information. 
 Note: These are approximate timings, and some figures have not been independently confirmed. Devotees should consult a trusted local Panchang or astronomical moonrise calendar before breaking their fast. 
 Why Does Karwa Chauth Fall on Different Dates in Different Countries? 
 Karwa Chauth follows the Hindu lunar calendar, which uses lunar phases and tithi calculations to determine important festival dates. Unlike the regular calendar, a Hindu lunar day does not always begin at midnight. 
 The Chaturthi tithi begins and ends at the same instant worldwide, but its corresponding local clock time and calendar date differ by time zone. Local Panchang rules also help determine the appropriate fasting date. 
 For example, Karwa Chauth is observed on October 28 in Toronto and Vancouver, while India and London observe it on October 29. 
 Therefore, Indian families living abroad should follow a reliable calendar prepared for their location instead of relying solely on Indian timings. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Puja Vidhi: What to Do After Moonrise? 
 On Karwa Chauth, many married women begin their day before sunrise with Sargi, a traditional meal often prepared by their mothers-in-law. They then observe a fast and pray for their husbands’ health and well-being. 
 In the evening, women perform the Karwa Chauth puja, listen to the Vrat Katha and prepare for moonrise. After the Moon rises, they usually follow these rituals: 
 Offer Arghya to the Moon: Women offer water to the Moon while praying for their husbands’ long lives and happiness. 
 Perform the sieve ritual: In many families, women look at the Moon through a decorated sieve, also known as a channi. 
 Look at their husbands: After viewing the Moon, women look at their husbands through the sieve as part of the traditional ceremony. 
 Break the fast: The husband may offer water and a sweet or the first bite of food to his wife. 
 Share a meal: Families often end the celebration with a special dinner. 
 These customs can vary according to family traditions and regional practices. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 falls on October 28 in several cities across the USA and Canada and on October 29 in India, the UK and other countries. Since the Karwa Chauth 2026 moonrise time varies by location, devotees should check their local Panchang before planning evening prayers and fast-breaking rituals. Following the correct city-wise moonrise time helps families celebrate Karwa Chauth while observing their traditional customs, wherever they live.

 Frequently Asked Questions 
 When is Karwa Chauth 2026 in the USA and Canada? 
 Karwa Chauth falls on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, in several major cities across the USA and Canada, including New York, Toronto and Vancouver. 
 Why is Karwa Chauth celebrated on different dates in India and abroad? 
 The festival follows Krishna Paksha Chaturthi in the Hindu lunar calendar. Time zones and local Panchang calculations can result in different local observance dates. 
 Can women break their Karwa Chauth fast if the Moon is hidden by clouds? 
 Traditions differ among families and communities. If clouds hide the Moon, women can consult a trusted local Panchang and follow their family or religious customs. 
 Should Indians living abroad follow local moonrise timings or Indian timings? 
 Indians living abroad should follow the moonrise time and festival date applicable to their own city. Indian Standard Time conversions are useful for reference but should not replace local timings.
